name: Shalelu Andosana AP
source: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower

items.name: Hunter's Anthem
items.description:
This +2 striking longbow is carefully handcrafted from a length of flexible green-tinted wood, etched in a variety of runic symbols, and strung with a dawnsilver bowstring. When you shoot the bow in rapid succession, the echoing chords generated by the bowstring form a haunting dirge that evokes the inevitable end of all things. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Hunt Prey] class feature, the weapon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thundering] rune on Strikes against your prey.

Activate—Song of the Bow 2 (concentration)

Frequency once per day

Effect You shoot an arrow thrumming with the song of the bow. Make a Strike with the bow that deals damage as normal. As long as the Strike isn't a critical failure, the arrow explodes in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] around your target, dealing @Damage[5d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in the area, including the target, with a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect]. Any creature that critically fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] for 1 minute. If any creature in the area is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Undetected] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Unnoticed] by you, you learn its location, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Hidden] to you instead.

items.name: Katana
items.description: A katana is a curved, single-edged sword known for its wickedly sharped blade.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

items.name: Coyote Cloak (Greater)
items.description: This dusty coat is made of mangy brown-and-gray coyote fur. You gain a +2 item bonus to Survival checks. If you critically succeed at your Survival check to Subsist, you can feed four times as many additional creatures.

defensiveAbilities.name: Resilient Hunter
defensiveAbilities.description: When Shalelu rolls a success on a Fortitude or Reflex save, she gets a critical success instead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Favored Terrain
offensiveAbilities.description: Shalelu gains a Climb speed of 35 feet when she's in forested terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hunt Prey
offensiveAbilities.description: Shalelu designates a single creature she can see and hear, or one she's Tracking, as her prey. She gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek the prey and to Survival checks to Track the prey. The first time she hits her designated prey in a round, she deals an additional 2d8 precision damage. These effects last until she uses Hunt Prey again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nature's Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: Enemies are Off-Guard to Shalelu when they're in difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unimpeded Journey
offensiveAbilities.description: Shalelu ignores the effects of difficult terrain and treats greater difficult terrain as difficult terrain.

lv5spells.name: Gravity Weapon
lv5spells.description: You build up gravitational force and funnel it into your blows, leading to more powerful attacks with blade and bow alike. On your first weapon Strike each round, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice.

lv5spells.name: Soothing Mist
lv5spells.targets: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
lv5spells.description:
You call forth a magical mist that envelops a creature. The mist restores 2d8 Hit Points to a target living creature and ends one source of persistent acid, bleed, fire, poison, or void damage affecting it. If the creature is taking persistent damage from multiple sources, you select which one is removed. Against an undead target, you deal 2d8 vitality damage (basic Fortitude save); if it fails the save, it also takes (@item.rank) Persistent,vitality Damage damage.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing (or damage to an undead target) increases by 1d8, and the persistent vitality damage to an undead creature increases by 1.

lv5spells.name: Ranger's Bramble
lv5spells.description:
You cause plants in the area to entangle your foes, with the effects of Entangling Flora. A creature that critically fails the save takes (max(0,@item.level -1))d4 Bleed Damage damage in addition to being Immobilized. Escaping your bramble doesn't end the bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The bleed damage on a critical failure increases by 1d4.

lv5spells.name: Terrain Transposition
lv5spells.description: You mystically transpose your current location with another. While in a wilderness environment, you transport yourself and items you're holding to a clear space you can see within range. If you have Favored Terrain and both your starting and ending position are in your favored terrain, the range increases to 180 feet. If you have an animal companion and it is adjacent to you, you can transport it along with you to an adjacent open space, but if this spell would bring any other creature with you, even in an extradimensional container, the spell is lost.
